run_multinode_training: run multinode ConViT training on a SLURM cluster using submitit with configurable GPUs and nodes
submit_job_with_autoexecutor: submit a ConViT training job to a SLURM partition using submitit AutoExecutor with GPU parameters
create_trainer_checkpoint: create a Trainer checkpoint that requeues the job and resumes from the latest checkpoint file
setup_gpu_args: setup GPU arguments from the submitit JobEnvironment including rank, world size, and output directory
copy_python_files: copy all Python files from a source directory to a destination folder for job execution
